headword: {国語教育|こくごきょういく}

definitions.gloss: Japanese-language education; teaching of the national language
definitions.explanation: The teaching of reading, writing, and the Japanese language to native speakers in schools. {国語|こくご} here means the national language, i.e. Japanese, as a school subject.

examples.japanese: {国語教育|こくごきょういく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧さ。
⟦{小学校|しょうがっこう}→小学校：01055_shougakkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{国語教育|こくごきょういく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見直|みなお}されている→見直す：04579_minaosu⟧。
examples.english: Japanese-language education in elementary schools is being reexamined.

examples.japanese: ⟦{読書|どくしょ}→読書：03484_dokusho⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{習慣|しゅうかん}→習慣：01429_shuukan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧こと⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、{国語教育|こくごきょういく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧な⟦{役割|やくわり}→役割：03638_yakuwari⟧だ。
examples.english: Instilling a habit of reading is also an important role of Japanese-language education.

notes:
Written ⟦{国語|こくご}→国語：02739_kokugo⟧ (national language; Japanese as a school subject) + ⟦{教育|きょういく}→教育：01313_kyouiku⟧ (education). Distinct from teaching Japanese to foreigners.
